title: ID0407328-DC/Si-D/NO-[T241QR] Session fails during Parameter Discovery
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Session fails in P02_Parameter_Discovery
Solution:
The SECC side we get that the EV is closing the TCP connection during Parameter Discovery
the EV didn’t send the PilotState C and as such we didn’t start the session.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407328-DC/Si-D/NO-[T241QR] Session fails during Parameter Discovery CRM:00315002367
ID0407328-DC/Si-D/NO-[T241QR] Session fails during Parameter Discovery CRM:00315002367
additional_info.body:
Hi Melba and Simen, good afternoon.
I have checked the HLX charger issue from 1 of the days you provided to me previously.
It seems we are correct to say that the EV is not continuing the sessions:
As you can see here, we are waiting for the EV session start but we never get it, we don't even get the EV MAC so we cannot say for certain which bus it is.
From the SID we get somewhat similar:
After the authentication we fail, so it feels like the bus is not starting the session.
I spoke with our Vehicle Integration team and there is a similar issue with Solaris buses in a different country where we need to have the ignition ON before starting to charge otherwise the vehicle fails to start the sessions.
Can we please make some tests to see if this is the problem? Before we present this to Solaris we need to collect as much info as possible.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
